summary: Synthesized discussion signals: high-priority security incidents (OpenAI, OpenCode), model release chatter (DeepSeek), operator workflows (Claude Code review, Reddit agent failures), and infra growth (MCP surge, sandboxes, browser/runtime primitives). | Vendor signals: major product releases (Cursor, OpenRouter, AWS Bedrock), several infra/sandbox shifts (E2B, Daytona, Modal), and multiple security GHSA advisories affecting agent toolchains. | GitHub-only snapshot: mix of official vendor releases (Google, Microsoft, Cloudflare, Vercel, GitHub) and many repo-first agent frameworks/tools. No social/discussion sources present; many repo-only projects need corroboration before promotion. | Package-only shard: many new/updated MCP, eval, browser-agent, and VS Code agent extensions. Mix of vendor-backed mainstream packages (OpenAI, Oracle/OCI, Vercel, Amazon tooling) and numerous infra primitives (MCP servers, agent-eval, agent security). Missing social discussion corroboration.
